## HDR Delivery Workflow for Radiance:

From one scene-linear master (EXR sequence or HDR from SDR to HDR):

- EXR: the archive master, 16-bit half, untouched.
- HDR10: Peak fit (RUDRA) brings anything brighter than 1000 nits under it, keeping each pixel's luminance, so the display does not clip it. HDR10+ / Dolby Vision metadata measures that fitted picture shot by shot and writes hdr10plus.json, a Dolby Vision 8.1 dovi_tool JSON and an analysis JSON. Write encodes PQ (ST.2084) with Rec.2020 primaries and carries the HDR10+ metadata inside the H.265 file (needs an ffmpeg whose x265 has HDR10+, such as gyan.dev's full build; the receipt says if it was carried).
- SDR: ACES 2.0 Output Transform tone maps to sRGB/Rec.709, then Write saves H.264.

Match Read's working_space, Peak fit's image_space and Write's working_space. For a sequence, point Read's path at the frames (e.g. /shots/sh010.####.exr). Cuts: connect Scene Cut Detect's JSON to cut_data, or leave it empty and the metadata node finds the shots itself.

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

None: this workflow needs no model.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
